en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a hillside area with a prominent tall church with a tower on the left and several large institutional buildings on the right, likely a children's hospital, surrounded by trees, roads, and rail tracks in the foreground. Printed text at the top names the church, the children's hospital and the city in Swedish; a small reference code appears at the bottom left.
